query: The car pushes wide on slow corners at Hungaroring (js/circuits/hungaroring.js). I want to make turn-in sharper without breaking determinism: run a headless step-steer A/B on the front-axle grip constants, compare yaw response before and after, and tell me whether the change helped.
car feels super snappy/twitchy on turn in now?? can u do a quick sweep of ROAD_FOLLOW values and see which one feels less lazy, i dont want to eyeball it

Trail braking feels wrong: when I stay on the brakes into a corner the rear just steps out and I spin, even with assists off. Diagnose where in the grip model that comes from and propose a tweak I can verify.

Hitting the kerbs and walls feels weak. Add punchier feedback on collisions and gear shifts (screen shake, a short hit-stop, some particles) but it must not alter lap times or the physics-characterization results.

Before I merge the tyre grip change, compare the old and new physics settings on a skidpad and tell me whether pace or cornering balance moved, using the player-dyn VM comparison rather than screenshots.
The chase camera lags behind the car in fast corners and the framing drifts. Take a few before/after screenshots at Spa's Eau Rouge and tune the camera smoothing.
My gamepad steering feels twitchy: the stick dead zone is too small and the car turns in too sharply on light touches. Fix the saturation and axis calibration in the steering input code.
AI cars brake too late into turn 1 and understeer off the track on the grip they have; tune their brake targets and preferred lane in the driving code so they stop diving in.
